claims.text: PAD + T2DM: SGLT-2 inhibitors (canagliflozin, dapagliflozin, empagliflozin) and GLP-1 agonists ↓MACE.
claims.quote: In patients with PAD and type 2 diabetes, use of glucagon-like peptide–1 agonists (liraglutide and semaglutide) and sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT-2) inhibitors (canagliflozin, dapagliflozin, and empagliflozin) are effective to reduce the risk of MACE.
